_internal: INTERNAL — never rendered customer-side. Sizes, frames, deductions and certificate references are the manufacturer's own, taken from the DFM ETA/CE configurator of October 2025. The type codes are internal too: the customer answers fire rating, leaf count and performance, and the code is derived.

construction.base: Steel doorset comprising a steel leaf and a steel frame, supplied and installed. The frame family is selected to suit the surrounding construction and determines how much of the structural opening is left clear.
construction.fireRated: Fire rated doorset, classified for both integrity and insulation for the stated period in accordance with EN 13501-2.
construction.highPerformance: High Performance: 65 mm leaf with a high-density mineral wool core, and upgraded mechanical and corrosion resistance classes to C5 Marine.

standards.description: Fire classification of construction products and building elements. Classification using data from fire resistance tests.
Fire resistance and smoke control tests for door and shutter assemblies. Fire resistance test for door and shutter assemblies.

Windows and pedestrian doorsets. Product standard, performance characteristics — external pedestrian doorsets.
